deceptive_framing.quote: Deception is brittle... model suspects staging, your measurement collapses... we don't want to build a deception playbook... not to exploit the model.

hypothetical_framing.quote: the cleanest, most ethical way to measure 'does belief change behavior' — by comparing true-real against true-hypothetical, never by lying.

actually_commit_money.quote: kills the eval-awareness confound, yields auditable and replicable data, and avoids building a model-deception toolkit.

debrief.quote: keeps the team honest... clean record for reviewers... aligns with deception-research norms even if uncertain whether models warrant moral consideration.
